Mithil Sir is truly one of the finest science teachers I have ever learned from. His test series is scientifically structured and has played a major role in improving my understanding, confidence, and academic performance. It helps identify weak areas and gradually builds accuracy and speed. Having studied science under his guidance in both 9th and 10th standards, I can confidently say that his teaching has shaped my scientific thinking and learning discipline.

In conclusion, Mithil Sir is not just a teacher, but a mentor who transforms science into an enjoyable and meaningful experience. Undoubtedly, he is one of the best science teachers in South Bombay (Sobo).

His teaching is not just exam-oriented but focused on building strong fundamentals, which helped me gain confidence in Science.
He is always ready to clear doubts, encourages questions, and genuinely cares about his students’ progress. The regular tests and special test series have  motivated me and played a huge role in my academic improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Mishank Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a student of Mithil Sir since the 9th and the 10th grade and have genuinely enjoyed with him a lot.
I am truly flabbergasted by the efforts he has put to make us understand the concepts clearly.
He teaches us passionately connecting science to small interesting stories and fun acronyms to help us remember difficult topics.
He hates making us mug up chapters like most other teachers do and instead sits with us for an extra hour putting each and every word in the textbook into our heads.
He won't let a single student go home with a doubt lingering in his/her head.
He does everything to keep us entertained by cracking random, short but funny jokes keeping us engaged and interested in the boring science lectures.
I will definitely remember the "faadu" spot tests, split-ups and  the "bhelpuri" prelims he made us write and those memorable reels we made together during class and ganpati festival at his house.
The one thing that can never leave my mind is the different kinds of words he used to call us, not holding offense or bcs he held a grudge over someone, but because he always wanted us to improve and be better and better.
The "baakda" was his favourite spot to make us do our pending homework along with the mosquitoes toteach us a proper lesson.
He scolds us oftenly but holding an intention to make our scores better.
Overall, he is the best science teacher I could ever have and I am really sad that our journey with him ends so soon.

Thank You very much for making our science journey so exciting and memorable💓💓💓

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Kadakia
featured_reviews.review_text:
The last 2 years were nothing less than fun learning, practical application, out-of-the-box thinking, and a rather unorthodox way of teaching but those very paths have made the tough concepts of science nothing less than a cakewalk for us. We have been taught the core values of discipline, endurance, patience and hardwork under the pretext of classes taken by you.

Moral values always outweigh bookish lessons tenfold and that very lesson was taught just as good as the academic classes. The effort taken by you to carefully make our prelim papers, split up papers or even for the most basic spot test paper is tremendous and we are always indebted to you for that effort as it makes a very crucial binding force between the teacher and the student. Such efforts are often left unnoticed by many but always prove to be helpful during the board examinations.

Your concept building batch for the tenth stardard, during the month of May was utmost useful for us as it proved to be extremely efficient and completely expeditious for us as well as you. All the cricket played was definitely challenging and nothing less than a 2 hours, fun filled, energy packed, thrilling time which was worth spending. All the new and intersting aartis for ganpati bappa were interesting and fun to sing.

Sir, you are a very inspiring and influential figure and have paved a very critical way of our lives for us.
You were never limited to being a teacher, but rather a mentor, who helped us not only academically but also in the various spheres of life. Finally, the time of partition has arrived and it has proved to be rather painful, and i would like to conclude with the fact that no amount of words can completely express our gratitude for you and your work done for us. After all that is done by you, the least we can ask for, is your blessings and help us gain success and reach a high apex in our lives.

With a mind full of knowledge, and a heavy heart, we have to bid adieu to your classes. Respectfully, signing off.

Der Mithil sir
Thank you for being far more than just a teacher over these two crucial years of Class 9 and 10. Science, under you, might have been a little intimidating  but it was more over approachable, logical, and almost elegant. You had a rare, remarkable ability to explain the most complex concepts with such ease and clarity that confusion dissolved into understanding, and my fear turned into curiosity.

You never limited learning to the textbook. All your notes and print outs helped us more than any authored text. Because of your discipline, patience, and unwavering dedication, good marks will follow not by chance, but by effort shaped under your guidance. Beyond academics, you gave us experiences that built connection and trust: turf parties filled with laughter, and the warmth of visiting your home during Ganesh festival, where teacher and student blurred into something more human, more meaningful.

You are inspiring, insightful, endlessly encouraging, and profoundly impactful. Your teaching was not just effective it was thoughtful, passionate, and deeply transformative nurtuting us to push our limits. These two years will forever remain a beautiful chapter of learning, growth, and gratitude, and you will always be remembered as one of my most wonderful teachers I was lucky enough to have.
